title: YouTube Guitar Tab Parser
claim: Show HN: YouTube Guitar Tab Parser
why_good: Extracts guitar tabs from YouTube videos — a specific, delightful pain-solver for a large hobbyist audience (guitarists).
value: Self-taught players learning specific songs. Freemium, paid export.
risk: Takedowns, plus accuracy that is audible when wrong.

zh.claim: Show HN: YouTube 吉他谱解析器。
zh.why_good: 从 YouTube 视频里提取吉他谱——给庞大的爱好者群体(吉他手)解决一个具体、讨喜的痛点。
zh.value: 自学特定歌曲的琴友；免费+付费导出。
zh.risk: 下架风险，加上一错就被听出来的准确率。
zh.hook: 你真正想学的那首歌没有谱——只有 YouTube 上一个人在弹。会扒的人自己扒，剩下所有人就卡在这里。
zh.does: 把一段 YouTube 吉他演奏解析成能跟着弹的谱。
zh.gap: Ultimate Guitar 是一个「已有的谱」的库，库里没有的就等于没有；而大多数教学视频里那份谱其实就摆在画面和声音里，只是没人把它取出来。
zh.counter: 版权是这条线的死穴：UG 靠社区上传加一套下架流程活着，单个工具两样都没有。而且自动扒谱一旦被听出来是错的，学习者第二天就不再打开。
zh.differentiator: 只做用户自己找到的那一个视频；交出的谱要把机器不确定的小节显式标出来，让会弹的朋友五分钟改十二处，而不是从零扒。永不托管音频。冷启动：中文=B站吉他翻弹视频下面的「求谱」评论；英文=r/guitarlessons 的 anyone have a tab for this 帖。

voices.text: Some of my favorite songs don't have readily available tabs and I thought to ask, how does one play by ear?
voices.source: r/Guitar — 'Music Theory and Playing By Ear', 27 comments

hook: The song you actually want to learn has no tab — there is only a person on YouTube playing it. People who can already transcribe do it by ear; everybody else stops there.
does: Parses a YouTube guitar performance into a tab you can follow along with.
gap: Ultimate Guitar is a library of tabs that already exist; if it is not in the library it does not exist. Yet in most lesson videos the tab is right there in the picture and the sound — nobody takes it out.
counter: Copyright is the fatal line here: Ultimate Guitar survives on community uploads plus a takedown process, and a lone tool has neither. And the moment a learner hears that the auto-transcription is wrong, they never open it again.
differentiator: Only do the one video the user already found; hand back a tab that explicitly marks the bars the machine is unsure of, so a friend who plays can fix twelve of them in five minutes instead of transcribing from zero. Never host audio. Cold start (Chinese): 「求谱」 comments under B站 guitar covers; (English): the 'anyone have a tab for this' posts in r/guitarlessons.
consumer_angle: Someone learning a specific song alone; the deliverable is a tab they can play from tonight.
